audience: website owners and small teams who collect enquiries through Getform forms

useCases.title: Read the latest submissions of a form
useCases.text: List one page of a form's submissions with status and answers. Use a small page size or no answers to read less personal data.

useCases.title: Find the submissions from one sender
useCases.text: Search a form's submissions by keyword, such as an email address, and read the dates and answers of the matches.

useCases.title: Submit one entry on a visitor's behalf
useCases.text: Submit one new entry with the data you supply. The form's workflow then runs, such as emails and webhooks, and the entry counts against the plan.
